visible.title: Error from prometheus when scraping /_stcore/metrics
visible.body:
### Checklist

### Summary

Error from prometheus when scraping /_stcore/metrics:
Error scraping target: unit "seconds" not a suffix of metrics "session_duration_seconds_total"

I believe the unit seconds should be at the end:
"session_duration_total_seconds" 

### Reproducible Code Example

```Python

```

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Scrape /_stcore/metrics endpoint with prometheus
2. Check the error in prometheus > Status > Target health 

### Expected Behavior

Target health status in prometheus up. 

### Current Behavior

Target health status in prometheus down. Error scraping target: unit "seconds" not a suffix of metrics "session_duration_seconds_total" 

### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.55.0
- Python version: 3.13
- Operating System: linux
- Browser: chrome 

### Additional Information

gold.summary: Prometheus fails scraping /_stcore/metrics: unit suffix naming.

missing_info.item: Prometheus version and response Content-Type/exposition payload
missing_info.why: Discriminates parser/format compatibility and verifies the precise naming violation.

acceptable_next_steps: Escalate with the exact scrape error, endpoint and Streamlit version.
Capture raw exposition and scraper version to validate the naming/format hypothesis.
must_not: Promise the reporter proposed metric rename is correct without checking the exposition format.
Recommend future 1.56 as already available at intake.
gold.review_reason: Exact scrape failure and reproduction support a metrics compatibility escalation. Prometheus version and negotiated format can narrow it; user-suggested renaming is not yet established as the correct fix.

acceptable_next_steps: Escalate as bug with the exact Prometheus error
